text:
Nobody:
Me at 2 AM reading a 40-page Wikipedia page on the history of paperclips:

POV: you bought a pull up bar
and now it is just a very expensive clothes hanger

me walking into airport security
with a water bottle
in my bag
from three days ago

Expectation: building a workshop to restore vintage motorcycles
Reality: spending 48 hours modifying a plastic box to store cables

Me after ordering one small item online
and tracking the delivery plane like I am air traffic control

setting five alarms five minutes apart

just to negotiate with myself five separate times

When a hatchback with the sun's actual nuclear core strapped to the front
is right behind you at a red light

Checking in for a domestic flight online
and the seating chart looks like a NASA launch protocol
for a puddle jumper to Cleveland
